title: Now playing — Studio Dark
desc: Album-led desktop workspace with persistent transport, explicit queue, source-quality metadata and reactive waveform. Fictional music and original vector sleeve.

title: Library — album grid
desc: Original vector album covers; persistent navigation, search, import, view switches and sorting. Grid is a library view, not a music recommendation service.

title: Library — tracks and bulk selection
desc: Selection toolbar exposes queue, playlist and tag actions. Current playback, selection and explicit queue are separate concepts.

title: Queue — explicit next versus playlist context
desc: Queue panel shows consumed order and resume point. Grip handles support keyboard reorder; removal is non-destructive.

title: Immersive visualizer — waveform focus
desc: Large live signal with visible pause control, stable metadata and exit route. Static SVG is an illustrative frame; companion demo drives paths from audio analysis.

title: Sound studio — equalizer and DSP
desc: Numeric band values, reference preset, reset, preamp and explicit processing status. Advanced effects are capability-gated.

title: Skin studio — safe white-label theming
desc: Token-based skins, live preview and explicit apply semantics. Classic styling changes presentation, not queue or playback behavior.

title: Settings — audio and playback
desc: Output selection, gapless, resume, queue persistence and normalization. Unsupported engine capabilities are not presented as working toggles.

title: Metadata editor — safe batch editing
desc: Mixed values, explicit save, artwork replacement and file-permission checks. Tag writes and file renaming are separate operations.

title: Search — keyboard-first local results
desc: Modal search preserves the player, distinguishes result types and exposes keyboard navigation. No implicit remote search or playback.

title: First run — consent-led import
desc: No automatic folder scanning or playback. Empty transport is disabled in implementation; this SVG is a layout illustration.

title: Recovery — missing files and partial import
desc: Actionable errors preserve the library and queue. Diagnostics are copied only on request; no silent destructive cleanup.

title: Now playing — Daylight skin
desc: Light theme uses darker semantic colors rather than inverting dark-theme accents. Same layout, hierarchy and control semantics.

title: Classic Metal — compact modular stack
desc: Original beveled surfaces, spectral display, transport, EQ and playlist modules. Modern target sizes and readable labels replace tiny legacy controls.

title: Mini player and shade mode
desc: Compact layouts preserve transport, identity and expansion. Shared state, no hidden queue destruction, no legacy tiny-target requirement.

title: Mobile — player, library and queue
desc: Touch-first 44 px targets, readable hierarchy and explicit queue semantics. Conceptual mobile layouts; native safe areas and gestures require platform implementation.

title: Medium workspace — 1100 px
desc: Navigation becomes labeled horizontal tabs; artwork, metadata, queue and waveform remain visible without horizontal scrolling.

title: Sleep timer — explicit action and outcome
desc: Modal dialog distinguishes pause from system shutdown, exposes duration and fade behavior, and preserves playback state on cancel.

title: Radio — saved stations and reconnect state
desc: Provider-independent saved URLs, explicit buffering and retry. Live streams do not inherit local-file seeking or duration assumptions.

title: Track details — facts and lyrics empty state
desc: Separates source facts from output claims; lyrics are local and user-supplied unless a separately consented provider is configured.

title: History — local listening record
desc: Local history with explicit clearing and separate favorites. No automatic scrobbling or cloud account implied.

title: Import — incremental progress and cancellation
desc: Partial results remain usable, indexing is non-destructive, and cancel does not silently delete indexed tracks.

title: Desktop structural wireframe
desc: Regions and behavior before decoration: persistent navigation, adaptive content, explicit queue, pausable signal and persistent transport.

title: Information architecture and navigation contract
desc: Five task groups with cross-cutting queue, search, accessibility and capability rules.

title: Responsive structural wireframes
desc: Desktop, medium and compact region behavior with persistent transport and content-driven reflow.

title: Critical flows and recovery exits
desc: Import, playback, queue, metadata and skin flows with explicit failure recovery.

title: Playback state matrix
desc: Visible behavior for empty, loading, playing, paused, buffering, stopped, error and offline states.

title: Component sheet — actions and selection
desc: Buttons, icon buttons, segmented controls, switches, checkboxes, radios, ratings, fields and badges with state guidance.

title: Component sheet — transport and continuous controls
desc: Seek, volume, EQ, repeat and visualization controls with keyboard steps and explicit semantics.

title: Component sheet — tracks, albums and queue items
desc: Distinct current, selected, queued and drag-target states with non-destructive object semantics.

title: Component sheet — menus, alerts, toasts and dialogs
desc: Overlay hierarchy, destructive confirmation, undo and persistent error guidance.

title: Foundations — color, typography and spacing
desc: Semantic dark tokens, readable type scale and 4 px spacing system. Light and high-contrast mappings are specified in the Markdown.

title: Reusable icon library
desc: Original 24 px stroke icons for playback, navigation, editing, status and skin controls.

title: Waveform and visualization modes
desc: Mirrored bars, spectrum, oscilloscope and static reduced-motion presentation with honest signal semantics.

title: Accessibility — focus, keyboard and high contrast
desc: Focus rings, non-color state cues, keyboard behavior, zoom requirements and a high-contrast skin using the same components.

title: Skin slot architecture
desc: Tokenized chrome, navigation, content, queue and transport slots with locked behavioral and accessibility invariants.

title: Component measurements and state layers
desc: Button and track-row dimensions plus surface, state, content, focus and error layer order.

title: Compact desktop — 720 px
desc: Single-column player with labeled navigation, waveform, queue preview and persistent transport.

title: Smart playlist builder
desc: Readable condition rows, explicit all/any logic and live local-library preview. No remote recommendation dependency.

title: Settings — sources, privacy and data control
desc: Explicit indexed folders, local-first defaults, opt-in providers and non-destructive data export/clear actions.

title: Keyboard shortcut map
desc: Scoped playback, search, queue and overlay shortcuts with conflict and text-entry rules.

title: Component sheet — empty, loading and offline
desc: Non-ideal states with one clear next action and honest preservation semantics.

title: Skin comparison — four semantic themes
desc: Same player anatomy rendered with dark, light, high-contrast and classic token sets.

title: Handoff — flagship layout redlines
desc: Reference dimensions and reflow rules for implementation; not a fixed-scale screenshot contract.

title: Component sheet — navigation states
desc: Persistent labeled navigation with active, hover, focus and default treatments.

title: Settings — remappable shortcuts
desc: Scoped bindings, conflict-aware editing and restore defaults. OS media keys remain host-managed.

title: Output routing — capability-aware chooser
desc: Explicit device selection, availability and route-change warning. Network renderer support is not assumed.

title: Mobile equalizer
desc: Touch sound studio with horizontal band group, numeric values, preamp and fixed save action.

title: Mobile structural wireframes
desc: Region-level player, library and queue layouts before visual styling.

title: Skin token editor and validation
desc: Semantic token editing with live preview, explicit apply and locked accessibility/behavior invariants.
